content:
Welcome back to this week's look at the new arrivals at the Apple Certified Refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new configurations of the MacBook Air, the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to save money, letting you buy Apple products directly from Apple's official website at up to 15% off.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Outstanding quality at great prices
  • Goes through a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be added to your purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and price drop at the Apple Certified Refurbished store so you don't have to. Inventory changes quickly, so we hope this report helps you find what's in stock and snag your desired product before it sells out.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain what I consider the best value picks. Both are great options for those entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time, or upgrading to Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago we first reported that the Studio Display XDR was available at the Apple Refurbished store. As we've consistently warned, inventory can change quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The perpetually under-stocked base model Apple TV 4K is back this week, alongside the long-available higher-end Ethernet version. The base model typically sells out fast, so grab one quickly if you want one.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi plus Ethernet: $209 (originally $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day, and if you want to join the club, the Apple Refurbished store has some solid deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm Black Titanium Case with Black Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm Natural Titanium Case with Anchor Blue Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799)

As always, you can head over to 9to5Tocks to stay on top of the latest Apple deals throughout the week.
